items.subject: verified Helper source, original ABI names, and exact business subtypes
items.reason: The observed production Helpers are unverified and four selectors only support opaque observed-v3/v4-path-a/b names.
items.requiredFollowUp: Obtain verified source or independently reproduce all fields with traces and at least ten samples per semantic subtype before enabling a production codec.

items.subject: Helper upgrade trigger, compatibility, ownership, and reported 93-byte runtime delta
items.reason: Historical evidence mentions a newer runtime size but does not prove its behavior, upgrade selection, old-position compatibility, or rollback policy.
items.requiredFollowUp: Capture both runtime versions, creation transactions, owner calls, selectors, traces, code diff, registry history, and rollback behavior before freezing a supersession transition.

items.subject: fee ownership, fee recipient selection, bps bounds, and accounting basis
items.reason: Observed calldata and receipts show several fee recipients and bps values, but the provided fee wallets are not hard-coded and global ownership or policy is unproven.
items.requiredFollowUp: Obtain the authoritative fee policy and version history, then reconcile recipient token flows and exact fee basis across every enabled operation.

items.subject: collect, decrease, exit-to-one-token, rebalance, and migration atomicity
items.reason: Historical evidence contains direct PositionManager calls and multi-transaction sagas; it does not prove that exits or migrations are one Helper transaction.
items.requiredFollowUp: Capture successful and failed transaction sequences for each operation and Helper version, including receipts, logs, balances, NFT state, and recovery cursor.

items.subject: router ABI, selector allowlist, spender behavior, and route validation
items.reason: The router and spender are observed, but a complete authoritative ABI and reviewed selector/token/recipient policy are not frozen; the registry allowlist is intentionally empty.
items.requiredFollowUp: Freeze authoritative router and spender interfaces, decode every allowed route shape, review code hashes, and pass malicious calldata plus provider-change tests.

items.subject: production token allowlist and non-standard token behavior
items.reason: No production policy classifies fee-on-transfer, rebasing, callback, false-return, USDT-style approval, or malicious tokens.
items.requiredFollowUp: Publish a versioned token policy with code hashes and test every supported behavior in Foundry and fork fixtures.

items.subject: creation bytecode, deployment gas, address prediction, and deployment idempotency
items.reason: Observed Helpers were owner-EOA direct deployments, but creation code and a reviewed deployer are not part of this reference freeze.
items.requiredFollowUp: Freeze creation bytecode and hash, verify immutable owner patching, deploy on testnet, exercise duplicate and dropped deployment recovery, and complete security review.

items.subject: Anvil fork and BSC testnet execution evidence
items.reason: P05-01 performs only mainnet reads and offline replay; it does not execute approve, Permit2, swap, mint, increase, collect, decrease, refund, or sweep.
items.requiredFollowUp: After review, save successful and failed fork plus testnet fixtures for all four platforms and every required security case.

items.subject: independent Helper, adapter, operation, and registry security review
items.reason: A contract freeze and offline codec regression are not an implementation audit or custody approval.
items.requiredFollowUp: Complete architecture, Solidity, signer-boundary, route-validation, and incident-recovery reviews and close all findings before testnet writes.

items.subject: authenticated target API responses and complete desktop/mobile operation states
items.reason: Public and bundle paths exist, but authenticated redacted responses and visual states for every quote, position, Helper, recovery, and approval case are absent.
items.requiredFollowUp: Capture approved authenticated response fixtures and desktop/mobile states, then compare them without promoting bundle candidates to official facts.
